The extraction states a database by its name and its native ID and writes no owner. The read of the dev account states the same native ID with its owner, and N2 joins the two. A document states a database of the same name in the production account. N3 compares the owner of the document's description with the owner of the node as N2 left it, so the database of the other account is a node of its own, and its role does not land on the dev database.
